description: After the main session submits one whole-mod review, report exact usage summed across its reviewing subagents: taskId, inputTokens (uncached), outputTokens, cacheReadTokens and cacheWriteTokens. All four counts are required together. totalTokens alone remains a fallback with unknown split. Claude Code: read transcripts by agentId, counting each assistant message.id once, never its displayed context-size total. Codex: use exact session log token-count events if available, otherwise skip. Only your own submitted reviews, within a day. Identical reports are a no-op; different counts or splits are refused. Never guess or send transcripts. AI tokens given to defense means total processed, the sum of all four.

taskId.description: The whole-mod task submitted by this account.

totalTokens.description: Fallback only: processed total with unknown split.
